popupExpandToggleTip: Instead of capturing the inner scrolling panels and iframes as they are showing, make them as large as their full content. For frames of another site one additional permission is asked one time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and get synced into your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: The permission has been obtained — frames of other sites are expanded too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames of another site are captured just as they look. Panels and iframes of that same site always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: In the text that the page exposes it searches for e-mails, telephone numbers, credit card numbers, national identity numbers (SSN) and API keys and places a solid black block over what is found, in the saved image. It cannot read text drawn as pixels — canvas, image, PDF, video frame. The recognition runs on your own device; nothing at all is ever sent anywhere. This applies to captures of the whole page (document scroll); the block is permanent, so check the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF runs everywhere. WebM is smaller and more smooth (it is recorded live right in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: To open these pages a one-time permission is needed the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages was not given.
redactActsNone: The redaction found nothing matching in the text it read and did not make any block. Nothing below is outlined.
redactActsShortfall: The redaction found 3 matches and covered 2.
redactActsUncoveredOne: 1 match is not covered in this image.
redactActsUncoveredOther: 2 matches are not covered in this image.
reviewLimit: FullShot reads the text that the page makes available. It cannot see this image. Anything made as pixels – canvas, image, PDF page, video frame – was never read.
reviewNoMarks: No block is outlined in the image below.
